messages:
marco_marketing: Quick thread — release-day trigger for tomorrow. Need final changelog blurb, docs permalink, webinar demo link, and inbound routing rules.
elaine_pm: timeline looks good on my side. can marketing post the short changelog we want to use?
tyler_eng: i pushed last-minute docs fixes to staging; will flip prod permalink after deploy.
sophia_docs: i'll prep the demo notebook and short runbook, upload link in a sec.
marco_marketing: ideal: 2 bullets + 1 sentence impact blurb for the release email. example: `Batching upgrades -> lower per-token cost`, `Streaming improvements -> better chat latency under load`. @tyler_eng can we say "~15% lower token cost for embedding-heavy flows"?
tyler_eng: that's reasonable for the common embedding profile we tested. add caveat: "typical" workloads; enterprise customers may vary.
elaine_pm: ok i'll craft bullets: 1) 15% typical token cost reduction for embeddings, 2) streaming + function-calling latency improvements. keep it tight.
marco_marketing: perfect. @sophia_docs can you drop the docs permalink here once prod is live so we can slot into the registration confirmation and press pack?
sophia_docs: uploading now -> https://drive.redwood.ai/s/rel-2-1-demo (slides + notebook). will post docs permalink after tyler flips prod.
maria_ops: tagging deploy-bot to trigger the canary at T+5m from planned 10:00 PST start.
deploy-bot: Release trigger accepted. starting canary rollout at 10:05 PST. I'll post status updates in #release-war-room.
marco_marketing: marketing ask: wait 30m after canary success before social + email blast to watch telemetry. target social post: 10:45 PST.
tyler_eng: agreed. fallback plan in case canary shows increased 95th p99: hold social, post update in this thread, and we'll roll back. :white_flag:
marco_marketing: inbound lead routing: set HubSpot workflow tag `rel-2.1` and route enterprise leads to SDR queue A, PLG leads to self-serve nurture. @elaine_pm please confirm you'll paste the workflow before EOD.
elaine_pm: will create workflow now and paste the webhook + sample audience.
marco_marketing: last check — webinar registration confirmation needs: docs permalink, slides link, demo notebook link, and a 1-line what-changed blurb. once docs permalink is up i'll draft the email.
sophia_docs: docs permalink (prod): https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/final — includes API example and migration note.
marco_marketing: lovely. i'll draft the email and share for a quick PR. thanks all — will hold here for any last-minute deploy signals. :pray:
